create_vm_snapshot_info1: Create a snapshot for the VM
delete_vm_snapshot_desc: Are you sure to delete VM snapshot <1>{name}</1>?
delete_vm_snapshot_desc3: This operation cannot be undone. This snapshot uses logical space
delete_vm_snapshot_desc4: . The space may not be freed immediately after deleting the snapshot.
no_match_filter_vm_snapshot: There are no VM snapshots matching the filter conditions
rollback_fail_vm: Failed to roll back the VM
rollback_fail_vm_desc: VM <1>{name}</1> {status}. Please make sure that the VM is shutdown before performing the rollback operation.
rollback_vm_desc: Are you sure to roll back the VM <1>{vmName}</1> to the state of snapshot <3>{vmSnapshotName}</3>?
rollback_vm_desc3: The following virtual disk in the VM <1>{vmName}</1> was deleted after the snapshot <3>{vmSnapshotName}</3> was created. Rollback will rebuild the virtual disk and mount it to the VM
rollback_vm_desc4: The snapshot does not contain the following virtual disks. Rollback will cause the virtual disks unmounted
vm_disk_will_remounted: The virtual disk that will be rebuilt and remounted
vm_disk_will_uninstall: The virtual disk that will be unmounted
fs_consistent_snapshot_desc: Create a file-system consistent snapshot by flushing memory data to the virtual disk. The virtual machine will be temporarily unavailable during this period.
fs_consistent_disabled_snapshot_desc: Create a file-system consistent snapshot by flushing memory data to the virtual disk, which is only available when VMTools is running properly.
error_vm_snapshot_name_exist: A VM snapshot with the same name already exists in the cluster.
create_vm_snapshot_vmtools_desc: If the virtual machine has VMTools mounted, neither the snapshot taken from it nor the virtual machines rebuilt afterwards will not contain this VMTools. Also, whether the virtual machine rolled back to this snapshot state has VMTools mounted is the same as before rollback.
create_vm_snapshot_rollback_vmtools_desc: When rolling back from a snapshot, the VMTools image is mounted in the same state as before the rollback.
vm_snapshot_sriov_alert_message: The virtual machine snapshot will not include any SR-IOV pass-through NIC mounted on the virtual machine.
